summary: Master customer advocacy and community-led growth. Learn the CMX framework, ROI modeling, and ambassador program design in this 5-day professional course.
lede: Customer advocacy and community building use purposeful communities to organize customer participation and peer engagement. The course is for community, customer success, marketing and advocacy practitioners who need to plan and manage these efforts. Participants explore how to measure community impact and lead attribution, design ambassador recruitment and engagement, and establish moderation and escalation practices.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for practitioners and leaders who are responsible for the strategic health and growth of customer ecosystems.
audience: Lifecycle Marketing Lead focused on post-purchase customer
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in community management, customer success, or marketing. Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and basic data analytics is highly recommended. Pre-reading on the CMX SPACES model will be provided upon registration.
